title: Gaskets and Packings, Part 1: Composition Cork
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard (Part 1) specifies characteristics of composition cork material intended to be used as gasket in various industries. 1.2 This standard apphes to composition cork sheets, slabs or frames obtained by pressure with granulated cork protein or resin bonded, with or without rise of temperature.
